name: Strathmore Plus Uranium Corp.
summary: Strathmore Plus Uranium Corp. operates as an early-stage mineral exploration company dedicated to identifying, acquiring, and advancing resource properties. The company possesses key uranium interests in Wyoming, which include the Night Owl property and the Agate project, both located within the Shirley Basin Uranium District. Furthermore, it holds ownership of the Beaver Rim project, an asset consisting of 131 unpatented lode mining claims extending over roughly 1,095 hectares in the Gas Hills Uranium District of Central Wyoming. Founded in 2007, the corporation previously traded under the name Strathmore Plus Energy Corp. and maintains its principal office in Kelowna, Canada.
